title: KeyRevocationView
description: Read-optimized projection of an elohim-DNA Content key-revocation entry (content_type 'governance-action:key-revocation'). Source of truth: DHT. Rebuildable via signal replay on the ElohimContentSignal dispatcher.

dhtAnchorHash.description: Hex-encoded Holochain ActionHash of the source Content entry.

id.description: Coordinator-generated ID (primary key of the projection).

subjectHumanId.description: String id of the human whose key is being revoked.

reason.description: One of REVOCATION_REASONS: compromised, stolen, challenge_upheld, voluntary.

initiatedByCid.description: CID of the initiating agent (was: initiatedBy).

requiredVotes.description: Votes required to reach threshold. 1 for voluntary; >=2 for steward_vote/challenge.

thresholdReached.description: True when currentVotes >= requiredVotes and the revocation is effective.

effectiveAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when revocation became effective. Null while pending.

derivedCompromiseAt.description: EPR W2D: ISO-8601 timestamp when compromise was derived (specialist attestation, challenge upheld, etc). Null if not applicable.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last update (e.g., when threshold was reached).
